workflows_create_description: Name the draft now. You can build its first step in the workspace next.
workflows_error_name_required: Give this workflow a name to continue.
workflows_error_name_too_long: Keep the name to 255 characters or fewer.
workflows_notices_heading: {name} is active, with something still to do

match.countPlural=one: Delete 1 workflow ({preview})? This cannot be undone.
match.countPlural=other: Delete {count} workflows ({preview})? This cannot be undone.

workflows_empty_body: A workflow starts as a private draft, then grows into the automation your product needs.
workflows_empty_filtered_body: Loosen the search or filter above, or clear it to see everything again.
workflows_select_all: Select all workflows on this page
workflows_rename_description: The name is the only thing that changes — nodes and revisions stay.
workflows_delete_active_note: This workflow is active — deleting it stops its triggers.
workflows_delete_description: Its executions stay in history. This cannot be undone.
workflows_import_result_description: What the file became. Read the report, re-point any webhooks, then open the workflow.
workflows_import_description: Bring an n8n workflow export. Unsupported nodes arrive as visible placeholders, never silent remaps.
workflows_paste_disabled: Pasting is disabled while a file is chosen — clear the file above to paste instead.
workflows_name_default_placeholder: Defaults to the name in the file
workflows_error_file_read: That file could not be read. Try again or paste the export instead.
workflows_error_choose_source: Choose an n8n export file or paste one below to continue.
workflows_error_invalid_json_named: {name} is not valid JSON. Export the workflow from n8n again and retry.
workflows_error_invalid_json: That text is not valid JSON. Paste the whole n8n export and retry.

match.countPlural=one: This workflow will not activate until the {count} blocking issue is fixed.
match.countPlural=other: This workflow will not activate until the {count} blocking issues are fixed.

workflows_report_blocking_note: Each one names the node to open below.
workflows_report_ok: This workflow will activate as imported.
workflows_report_ok_note: Read the lossy and dropped entries and decide whether the differences matter.
workflows_webhook_addresses_note: Every webhook URL changes on import — prefix it with your host and point the sending system at the new address. The old path will not work.
workflows_no_webhooks: No triggers in this workflow needed a public address.
workflows_error_copy: Copying failed in this browser — select the address above and copy it by hand.
workflows_import_empty_note: No issues — everything in this file carried exactly.
workflows_editor_load_failed: Workflow editor could not be loaded
workflows_editor_stale: This editor may be out of date — the last refresh failed: {message}
workflows_newer_revision: A newer revision ({revision}) was saved elsewhere while you were editing.
workflows_unsaved_confirm: This workflow has unsaved changes. Leave and discard them?
workflows_run_watch_stopped: This editor stopped watching a run that is still going. Check the execution history for its final state.
workflows_export_description: What this workflow becomes outside KilasFlow. Read what does not carry before downloading.
workflows_export_mappings_prefix: This instance advertises {count} node-type mappings. The live list travels with every export response under
workflows_export_mappings_suffix: — if that list and any guide disagree, the instance is right.
workflows_export_empty_note: Nothing was lost — every node and connection in this workflow has an n8n equivalent.
workflows_severity_blocking_meaning: The workflow cannot run as imported.
workflows_severity_blocking_action: Fix it. The workflow will not activate until you do.
workflows_severity_lossy_meaning: The element was carried, but differently.
workflows_severity_lossy_action: Read it and decide. The workflow will activate.
workflows_severity_dropped_meaning: The element was not carried at all.
